review:
Le Hooligan is the higher-volatility twin of Le Football Fan, with the same stadium theme and Smokey rallying the crowd. Wins are cluster-based, and winning positions become Marked Squares that can transform into Coins, Clover symbols and Buckets of Gold.

Three, four or five FS symbols trigger one of three bonus games. Hacksaw rates it 3/5 volatility with a 10,000x max win, four times Le Football Fan's ceiling, and publishes RTP versions of 96.34%, 94.23% and 92.17%. It suits players who like the football theme but want a bigger top prize.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Casinos can run versions as low as 92.17% RTP
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
